# Frontend Review

Read AGENTS.md first. Then follow this workflow.

Use the `frontend-reviewer` agent to review React frontend conventions.

Scope: $ARGUMENTS

Rules:
- Use only when the React profile is enabled or the task explicitly touches React files.
- Read-only review.
- Check components, hooks, CSS Modules, context, and store hooks.
